requirements.value: Applicant must have graduated from a recognized school, the other state must maintain standards equal to or higher than Connecticut, and applicant must show good professional standing. No license issued if disciplinary action is pending or unresolved complaint exists.
requirements.quote: if the department finds that such applicant has been graduated from a chiropody or podiatry school or college recognized by the Connecticut Board of Examiners in Podiatry at the time of his graduation from such school or college and that such state board or licensing agency maintains standards for licensure determined by the department to be equal to or higher than those of this state, and that he has presented to said department evidence showing him to be of good professional standing

is_mandatory.quote: No person other than those described in section 20-57 and those to whom a license has been reissued as provided by section 20-59 shall engage in the practice of podiatry in this state

title_protection.quote: any person who uses the title "podiatrist" or any word or title to induce the belief that such person is engaged in the practice of podiatry, without complying with the provisions of this chapter, shall be guilty of a class D felony

scope_protection.quote: Any person, except a licensed podiatrist, a licensed naturopathic physician or a physician or surgeon licensed under the provisions of chapter 370, who practices or attempts to practice podiatry

definition_quote.value: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment, including medical and surgical treatment, of ailments of the foot and ankle and all the anatomical structures of the foot and ankle and the administration and prescription of drugs incidental thereto, in accordance with section 20-54.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis and treatment, including medical and surgical treatment, of ailments of the foot and ankle and all the anatomical structures of the foot and ankle and the administration and prescription of drugs incidental thereto

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and treatment, including medical and surgical treatment, of ailments of the foot and ankle and all the anatomical structures of the foot and ankle and the administration and prescription of drugs incidental thereto

drug_authority.value: May prescribe, administer and dispense drugs and controlled substances in schedule II, III, IV or V in connection with the practice of podiatric medicine
drug_authority.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine, licensed pursuant to this chapter may prescribe, administer and dispense drugs and controlled substances in schedule II, III, IV or V, in accordance with section 21a-252, in connection with the practice of podiatric medicine.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the portions of skin, subcutaneous tissue, fascia, muscles, tendons and nerves at or below the level of the myotendinous junction of the triceps surae

amputation_authorized.quote: Podiatric surgery shall not include amputation of the leg or foot other than from the transmetatarsal level to the toes.

anesthesia_authority.quote: Podiatric surgery requiring an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic shall be performed in a facility accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations or a freestanding surgery center accredited by the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: A licensed podiatrist may independently engage in the surgical treatment of the ankle, including the surgical treatment of the anatomical structures of the ankle

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Graduation on or after June 1, 2006, from a three-year residency program in podiatric medicine and surgery that was accredited by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education, or its successor organization, at the time of graduation

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Podiatric surgery requiring an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic shall be performed in a facility accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations or a freestanding surgery center accredited by the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: "Podiatric medicine" includes treatment of local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the foot and ankle

systemic_disease_local_manifestations_in.quote: "Podiatric medicine" includes treatment of local manifestations of systemic diseases as they appear on the foot and ankle, in accordance with section 20-54.

value: American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery
board_certification_body.quote: A licensed podiatrist who is board qualified or certified by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery or the American Board of Podiatric Medicine, or said boards' successor organizations

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: Each person licensed to practice podiatric medicine under the provisions of section 20-54 or 20-57 who provides direct patient care services shall maintain professional liability insurance or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice.

total_ankle_replacement_authorized.quote: a licensed podiatrist who has provided documentation to the Department of Public Health of meeting the requirements set forth in subdivision (1) or (2) of subsection (c) of section 20-54 may apply to a hospital in the state for privileges to perform total ankle replacement surgery at such hospital

tibial_pilon_fracture_excluded.quote: shall not treat tibial pilon fractures

hospital_privileges_nondiscrimination.quote: The Department of Public Health's issuance of a license to a podiatrist to independently engage in surgery shall not be construed to obligate a hospital or outpatient surgical facility to grant such licensed podiatrist privileges to perform such procedures at the hospital or outpatient surgical facility.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit or restrict the sale or fitting of corrective, orthopedic or arch-supporting shoes or commercial foot appliances by retail merchants

office_based_surgery_accreditation_requi.quote: Podiatric surgery requiring an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic shall be performed in a facility accredited by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations or a freestanding surgery center accredited by the Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care
